prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one square full-bleed Facet variant of an existing fantasy ability card.
Input images: Image 1 is the FINAL BASE ILLUSTRATION and the edit target. Image 2 is the approved Magic Missile paint STYLE REFERENCE; Image 3 is the approved Spirit Slash paint STYLE REFERENCE. Images 2 and 3 guide only the coarse painterly medium; do not insert their missiles or blade.
Primary request: make the mechanic-specific variant described below by editing only the foreground ability in Image 1. Preserve its atmospheric architecture, arches, amber depth, perspective and neutral serious mood. Preserve its coarse matte gouache, broad brush marks, rough edges and simple flat shadow planes, at exactly the intentionally coarse finish of the approved references.
Composition: square, full-bleed atmospheric scene, not bare paper. Subject remains central and readable at 40px; keep the lower 20% quiet for the card fade. No letters, numbers, labels, title, card border or watermark.
Constraints: preserve the base ability's identity and painted palette, make this Facet visibly distinct through the mechanic itself, no new villain, enemy, sinister face or antagonist background. No HD rendering, photorealism, smooth glossy lighting, realistic material textures, lens effects, bokeh, intricate engraving, extra hardware or sci-fi machinery. Do not refine the brushwork into tiny detail.
Facet rule (meaning only, do not write it in the image): Activating heals 15% of max HP.
Foreground edit: preserve the protected amber life-pulse and its broad ivory rib-shaped ward. Paint a clearly visible warm healing wave leaving the core, a broad ivory-and-amber pulse flowing gently outward into the surrounding scene. The protection remains intact while healing energy emerges from it. Use a few large readable strokes and a calm recovery mood. No literal heart anatomy, medicine symbols, blood, hardware or machine.
source_mode: facet edit of final base illustration
